to.author: agent
to.tooltip:
**Everything leaves here now.** This used to be where the 0.70 gate dropped low-confidence Signals silently. It doesn't any more — the gate moved to its own view and became a router (ADR 0003).

What leaves this box is every scored Signal, high and low. What happens to the low ones is a decision, and a human makes it.
